spine.deviation_notes: Minor drift: Tempest Bell's defining texture -- a placed proxy that does nothing on its own and only pulses WHEN YOUR OWN MELEE HITS IT -- collapses into a totem (placed proxy) whose proc is expressed via trigger_grammar (on-hit-threshold -> resource-fill/pulse). The engine's totem is more autonomous than the bell's 'you must ring it yourself' dependency, so the player's 'I attack my own bell to weaponize it' loop reads as a more self-sufficient sentry. The dual-currency (Combo Points to summon + Power Charges to Falling-Thunder) is modeled as one accumulator + a charge bank. Recognizable, slightly-hollowed proxy identity -> CLOSE.

skills.delivery_notes: multi-hit quarterstaff attack at melee range that builds Combo Points AND strikes the placed bell to ring it -> melee_arc (mirrors gemling-stacker's Tempest Flurry=melee_arc precedent; the flurry is the same skill). lightning. ailment=sunder (poe2 shock damage-amp band; no paralysis attested for this kit -> S-A BINDING). This is the Combo-Point BUILDER and the bell-RINGER in one motion.

placed at target position (Combo-Points SUMMON it, up to 3 in 0.5); a stationary proxy that pulses lightning damage in a small radius EACH TIME the player attacks/rings it -> totem (placed stationary object struck by the player; totem/sentry phrase-book). 0.5s cooldown between summons. lightning. The bell is a player-amplified placed proxy: the player must manually RING it (light proxy), so the payoff is gated on the melee flurry hitting it.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Build Combo Points with Tempest Flurry -> summon Tempest Bell (up to 3) -> keep striking the bells to ring them, each ring pulsing lightning in a small AoE. Boss: place 3 bells, then Falling Thunder burst with 6 Power Charges + 20 Combo.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-03 (corpus gx). Tempest Bell -> totem (placed stationary proxy struck-to-proc; the corpus 'light proxy' read + phrase-book totem/sentry). Tempest Flurry -> melee_arc per the gemling-stacker Tempest-Flurry=melee_arc precedent (HOT-FLAG 7 consistency: same skill name, flurry-with-AoE shape) -- distinct from ice-strike's melee_strike (which is a small single-contact Ice Strike, a different skill). shock->sunder (S-A BINDING; no paralysis attestation). chain_count=3 per R-M2 (Tempest Flurry + Tempest Bell + Falling Thunder finisher = 3 load-bearing actives). Combo-Point builder-spender -> accumulator + resource-fill (Section-B precedent). PROXY_ASCENSION routes the bell-as-placed-amplifier-proxy; TEMPORAL_CHARGE routes the Combo/Power-Charge engine. Invoker/Martial-Artist ascendancy -> t4 via 5 (R-M1). eras 0.1-0.5 CONFIRMED.
